title: Onboard mirabel-13b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Sofia Patel
body:
Motivation: Add support for the new mirabel-13b-v1.0 model in the model registry with complete metadata, validated performance profiles, and automated changelog/release-note generation. This PR wires mirabel into the onboarding pipeline so it shows up in the model catalog and release notes automatically.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds canonical metadata for mirabel-13b-v1.0 (author, license, tokenizer, supported ops, model files and checksums, recommended runtimes).
- Adds performance profiles (latency and throughput matrices) produced by the perf-harness for representative sequence lengths and batch sizes. Profiles include A100-40GB and V100 baselines plus quantized/float16 variants.
- Adds an entry to the model registry index and a lightweight validation hook for CI to ensure schema compatibility.
- Adds a small automation script (scripts/gen_changelog.py) and registry hooks so an entry in CHANGELOG.md is generated for new models and included in the release-notes artifact.
- Adds unit and integration tests for the metadata schema and a perf smoke test to guard regressions.

Checklist (completed):
- [x] Metadata YAML added and validated against schema v2.1
- [x] Perf profiles added and verified using perf-harness v3.2 (see commit summary)
- [x] Changelog automation added and integrated into registry CI job
- [x] Tests added and passing locally/CI

Notes and risks:
- The perf profiles were generated from a dedicated run on A100-40GB and validated against historical baseline for similar 13B models. P50 latency at seq 512 (single-GPU, batch=1) is ~110ms on A100-40GB (fp16), throughput for batch sizes up to 8 saturates at ~42 tokens/s depending on sequence length. These numbers are documented in perf_profiles/mirabel-13b-v1.0.json.
- We included quantized int8 profiles for customers using quantization; these are marked experimental until we complete broader QA (tracked in ENG-4301).
- Changelog automation inserts a new entry under models/CHANGELOG.md and emits a release_notes artifact. The generator is idempotent and guarded by a schema checksum to avoid duplicate entries.

Release impact: This makes mirabel-13b-v1.0 available for serving in hosted and dedicated modes once the model files are staged in the artifact store and infra config is applied. No breaking API changes.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) add mirabel metadata and index entry; 2) add perf profiles and perf-harness validation; 3) add changelog generation script and tests

review_comments: Ethan: please include the tokenizer spec (done) and confirm checksum method (replied: using sha256, added verification test). Maya: requested clearer labeling of experimental quantized profiles (done). Liam: asked for perf-run parameters and seed (added to perf_profiles metadata). After addressing comments, reviewers approved. Final: Approved by Ethan, Maya, Liam on 2026-02-20.

release_notes: Onboard mirabel-13b-v1.0: model metadata, performance profiles (A100-40GB, V100, fp16/int8 experimental), and automatic changelog generation for registry entries. See models/mirabel for details.
